entities.name: PMID:25071776
observations: In adult mice, 24-hour fasting increased adipose IL1R2 mRNA approximately 83-fold and liver IL1R2 mRNA approximately 9.5-fold; liver IL1RN mRNA increased approximately 68-fold.
Fasting increased liver IL-1R2 protein approximately 3.2-fold, liver IL-1RA protein approximately 2.5-fold, and adipose IL-1R2 protein approximately 1.8-fold.
Fasted mice were protected from exogenous IL-1β-induced weight loss, hypoglycemia, locomotor suppression, and social withdrawal, indicating reduced physiological IL-1 responsiveness.
Fasting increased plasma free fatty acids approximately 2.4-fold; palmitate administration increased hepatic IL1R2 approximately 14-fold and IL1RN approximately 11-fold.

Mifepristone blockade of glucocorticoid action did not prevent fasting-induced IL1R2 or IL1RN expression; palmitate sufficiency was shown, but necessity of palmitate or other FFAs was not established.
The study did not directly measure proximal IL-1R1 signaling such as NF-κB or MAPK activation and did not provide direct human fasting evidence.

entities.name: Fasting IL-1 resistance
observations: In adult mice, 24-hour fasting attenuated systemic responses to exogenous IL-1β, including weight loss, hypoglycemia, locomotor suppression, and social withdrawal.

entities.name: FFA IL-1 inhibitor induction
observations: Fasting-associated free fatty acids increased approximately 2.4-fold, and exogenous palmitate was sufficient to induce hepatic IL1R2 and IL1RN expression in mice.
The evidence supports an FFA-mediated pathway but does not establish that palmitate is necessary or the only relevant fatty acid.

entities.name: Palmitate
observations: In the 2014 mouse study, in vivo palmitate administration increased hepatic IL1R2 and IL1RN expression approximately 14-fold and 11-fold, respectively.

entities.name: IL1R2
observations: IL1R2 encodes the inhibitory/decoy IL-1 receptor type 2; its expression increased markedly after 24-hour fasting in mouse adipose tissue and liver and after palmitate administration in liver.

entities.name: IL1RN
observations: IL1RN encodes IL-1 receptor antagonist; its liver mRNA and protein increased after 24-hour fasting, and hepatic IL1RN expression increased after palmitate administration in mice.
